purpose_note: Development only - not for formal comparisons. Part A audit of a21a692: "Crop IDs match, but the decoding stacks produce different pixels from the same video. The first decoded frame differed by up to two intensity levels. The geometry shim also introduced small additional crop differences. Formal hardware comparisons must use the frozen canonical crop files, rather than independently regenerating crops on each machine."
notes: These crops were placed using the so3_exp_map stand-in in scripts/pytorch3d_shim.py (real pytorch3d is not installed on the Mac); it matches scipy Rotation.from_rotvec within 1e-6 (tests/test_so3_standin.py).
Part A's full evaluation should use real pytorch3d, not this stand-in.
